description.en: Sidebar Manager for DeepSeek Harness: purge, archive/restore, move, rename, and fork sessions and workspaces.
description.ko: 딥시크 하네스 사이드바 관리자: 세션·워크스페이스 삭제, 보관/복원, 이동, 이름 변경, 포크.

release.notes: Integrity hotfix v0.1.2. Finalizers now detach a session from its previous workspace before attaching it to the target, preventing duplicate ownership and boot-time registry corruption after a crash. Rollback no longer restores the whole workspace registry; only the transaction's session log, projection cache, and created directory are reverted. Verified with 5 transaction regression tests and 55 isolated Playwright E2E checks.
